summary.text: Amy Trask is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Chad Johnson.
She lost the 2024 Democratic primary for the same seat to David Arreola, 43.2% to 56.8%.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Trask described herself as a seventh-generation Floridian and mother who has waited tables and bartended and worked multiple jobs while in school and raising children.
She said she worked as an Undergraduate Fellow, Senior Fellow and Landscape Analyst at the Harvard Safra Center for Ethics and has spoken at the Bipartisan Policy Center.

She said she has authored policy on child welfare, domestic violence reform and health care, and named child welfare, health care, education, domestic violence reform and home rule among her priorities.
